message.content:
Warm beige wool-blend blazer, structured shoulder cut with notch lapels, #D8C7B8 color, medium-weight woven fabric.
Slim-fit charcoal grey wool trousers, straight-leg cut with a sharp crease, #36454F color, fine textured worsted fabric.
Cream silk shell blouse, relaxed fit with a rounded neckline and dropped shoulders, #FFFDD0 color, smooth lightweight fabric.
Leather loafers, almond-toe shape with a low block heel, #8B7355 color, full-grain calfskin leather.
Minimalist gold hoop earrings, 12mm diameter, solid metal, warm yellow gold finish.
A single dark brown leather belt matching the shoe tone, 1.5cm width, smooth vegetable-tanned leather.

This outfit strikes the perfect balance between professional polish and autumnal warmth, adhering to her "neat" preference for refined knits and textures while staying within the "everyday" comfort zone of office life. The neutral earth tones of beige, cream, and charcoal create a sophisticated backdrop that harmonizes beautifully with her deep warm skin undertones and rich brown hair without overpowering her features. By selecting a structured blazer over heavy outerwear for the +15°C autumn forecast, we respect her request for no unnecessary layers while ensuring the ensemble remains appropriately formal for the workplace setting.
